notes: Six ranks. Each carries a movement trait: Shinobi outrun Knights by moving tree to tree through forest, where ground units pay double.

ranks.title: Apprentice
ranks.description: Unproven trainee. Moves like any ground unit.

ranks.title: Genin
ranks.description: Field operative. Canopy step: forest costs 1 movement instead of 2.

ranks.title: Chunin
ranks.description: Cell leader. Canopy step, and stopping in forest hides the unit.

ranks.title: Jounin
ranks.description: Master operative. Canopy step, hide in forest, and enemies' zones of control do not hold them.

ranks.title: Anbu
ranks.description: Covert elite. All Jounin traits, +1 Movement, and may pass through allied hexes.

ranks.title: Kage
ranks.description: Shadow sovereign. All Anbu traits and Shadow Step: once per activation, relocate up to 3 hexes to any forest, smoke or ruins hex, ignoring everything between.

privilegeRules.canopy: Forest movement cost 1 (tree to tree). Knights and other ground units pay 2, cavalry 3.
privilegeRules.hideOnForestStop: Ending a move on a Forest hex applies Hidden.
privilegeRules.ignoreZoc: Leaving a hex adjacent to an enemy does not trigger a reaction attack.
privilegeRules.passAllies: May move through hexes occupied by allies.
privilegeRules.shadowStep: Shadow Step action: 1 AP, once per activation, teleport up to N hexes to a Forest, Smoke or Ruins hex.
